name: Mercenary Prestige
description: Phaethon Mercenaries have seized a nearby mining region and enslaved the locals. Gina's Eagles accepted a contract to remove them, but she worries they are overmatched. The event has Personal Challenges and Alliance Challenges.
requirements: Select a difficulty tier (Champions, Epic, Legends, or Fearless) and a level (Easy, Normal, Hard, Nightmare, or Insane)
Complete the event 20 times to unlock all difficulty levels
Complete Easy before you can reach harder tiers
Alliance Challenges: an R4 or R5 can request a Captain challenge after members defeat a set number of high-level Phaethon Soldiers

A scout costs 15 stamina and gives 1 hour to defeat the Mercenary. Solo costs 10 more stamina (8 with Gina at 4 stars) and a rally costs 25 more (20 with Gina). An Alliance Help Request uses 1 of your 5 free Mercenary Contracts, and helping another member earns +1 Contract.
